Simple Present Passive: Statements and Questions
When we want to give importance to the object of a sentence or when the subject is not important or unknown, the passive voice is used.

The passive voice is used in the simple present to talk about situations that occur on a regular basis and its doer is unknown or is not important.

What is understood by cloud computing?
Nowadays, cloud-computing services are becoming incredibly popular among all types of computer users, ranging from individual users to huge organizations. The popularity of cloud computing and its definition lies in its ability to provide computer processing resources on demand through an internet-based model. This means that an end customer will not need to install software and run its servers and applications. A cloud services supplier will provide applications and storage services from the supplier's data server center itself. This model allows users to be provided with computing resources with minimal management effort, and focus more on their business rather than on spending lots of money on software and hardware acquisitions.

What components are included in a cloud contract?
Cloud computing is a fast evolving computing technology. As more and more businesses are focusing on depending on cloud services, many legal issues and concerns may ensue. Data protection and security are addressed as the most common legal concerns. It is, however, necessary for both parties to review the following components in a cloud contract negotiation:

Terms of Service:
Also known as the “Terms of Use”. The general legal terms and conditions that establish the relationship between the vendor and the customer are set out in this part of the document, as well as how the service is used.
Privacy Policy:
This document lays out how the customer's information is approached in terms of privacy and protection.
Acceptable Usage Policy (AUP):
This a common contract component that is used in social networking sites and cloud computing services providers. It specifies what practices are allowed or prohibited when using the service (for example, banning hate speech, or spam prohibition).
Service Level Agreement (SLA):
The SLA states the levels of service availability and describe what cloud services are promised to the customer.
